events.title: Share your clips!
events.summary: Hey hunters!The Hunting Simulator 3 demo is now live on Steam until October 26, giving you the chance to explore Colorado and experience the hunt for yourself.Now, we want to see your best moments! Whether you've captured an incredible trophy, a breathtaking landscape, an impressive shot, or an unforgettable hunting moment, share it with us. We'll feature some of the best submissions on our official social media channels!screenshot from BlackwoodSailorHow to participateShare your best screenshot

events.title: Play the demo now - Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Dear Hunters,The wait is over! The Hunting Simulator 3 demo is available now on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest!Get your first taste of the hunt, explore the starting HQ, test your skills at the shooting range, and venture into a restricted area of Colorado.🐾 What can you expect in the demo?Explore the starting HQ and its shooting range.Discover a portion of the Colorado map.Take on the first mission: A Matter of Rabbits.Hunt three licensed species: Only these species can be hunted and bagged.

events.title: Steam demo is coming!
